SELECT A.prdct_id ,prdct_name ,V.cnt prdctCnt
,trde_prc ,(select 1) item_ty
,sale_prc trde_prc ,(select 2) item_ty
,sale_prc trde_prc ,(select 3) item_ty
,sale_prc trde_prc ,(select 4) item_ty
,(select brand_name from brand where brand_id=A.brand_id) brand_name
,(select color_name from prdct_color C WHERE C.color_id = A.color_id) ty1 ,(select color_name from prdct_color C WHERE C.color_id = A.color_id2) ty2 ,prdct_ty_cd ,(select img_path from still_img S where S.prdct_id=A.prdct_id limit 1) img_path
,(select name from lens_mtrl where ty_id = A.mtrl)ty1 ,(select name from lens_ty where ty_id = A.ty_id)ty2
,(select name from clens_ty1 where ty1_id = A.ty1_id)ty1 ,(select name from clens_ty2 where ty2_id = A.ty2_id)ty2
,unit_ AS ty1
FROM
prdct A
lens A
clens A
clens_acc A
inner join
invn V
lens_invn V
clens_invn V
clens_acc_invn V
ON A.prdct_id = V.prdct_id
V.shop_id = #{shopId}
and (brand_id = #{brandId})
and ( A.prdct_name like CONCAT('%', #{prdctName}, '%') )
and (prdct_ty_cd = #{prdctTyCd})
and (prdct_stat_ty_cd = #{prdctStatTyCd})

SELECT (select name from lens_detail_define where id = L.type1)brandName ,L.name prdctName ,L.prdct_id ,I.cnt prdctCnt ,L.type2 ty1 ,L.curve ty2 ,sale_prc trdePrc ,(select 2) item_ty FROM lens_invn I, lens_detail L WHERE I.prdct_id = L.prdct_id AND I.shop_id = #{shopId} AND (L.type1 = 0 or L.type1 = 1 or L.type1 = 2 or L.type1 = 3)
and ( L.name like CONCAT('%', #{prdctName}, '%') )

SELECT Y.sale_id ,X.prdct_id ,X.itemTy ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select prdct_name from prdct where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) WHEN '2' THEN (select name from lens_detail where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) WHEN '3' THEN (select prdct_name from clens where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) ELSE (select prdct_name from clens_acc where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) END AS prdct_name ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select color_name from prdct_color C WHERE C.color_id = (select color_id from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '2' THEN (select curve from lens_detail where prdct_id = X.prdct_id) WHEN '3' THEN null ELSE (select unit_ from clens_acc where prdct_id= X.prdct_id) END AS feature1 ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select color_name from prdct_color C WHERE C.color_id = (select color_id2 from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '2' THEN (select coating from lens_detail where prdct_id = X.prdct_id) WHEN '3' THEN null ELSE null END AS feature2 ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select ty_name from prdct_shape WHERE prdct_ty = (select prdct_shape from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '2' THEN (select type3 from lens_detail where prdct_id = X.prdct_id) WHEN '3' THEN null ELSE null END AS feature3 ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select mtrl_name from prdct_mtrl M WHERE M.mtrl_id = (select mtrl_id from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '2' THEN null WHEN '3' THEN (select name from clens_ty2 WHERE ty2_id = (select ty1_id from clens where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) ELSE null END AS mtrl ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select cntry_name from mnf_country WHERE cntry_id = (select mnf_country from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '2' THEN (select cntry_name from mnf_country WHERE cntry_id = (select origin from lens_detail where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '3' THEN (select cntry_name from mnf_country WHERE cntry_id = (select mnf_country from clens where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) ELSE (select cntry_name from mnf_country WHERE cntry_id = (select mnf_country from clens_acc where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) END AS mnfCountry ,CASE X.itemTy WHEN '1' THEN (select type_name from prdct_ty WHERE type_id = (select prdct_ty from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '2' THEN (select name from lens_ty WHERE ty_id = (select type1 from lens_detail where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) WHEN '3' THEN (select name from clens_ty2 WHERE ty2_id = (select ty2_id from clens where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) ELSE NULL END AS purpose ,X.prdct_cnt ,X.prc ,X.asmbly ,X.dlvry ,X.dscnt_prcnt ,X.earn_prcnt ,X.using_point ,X.inform FROM sale_off Y inner join salePrdct_off X on Y.sale_id = X.sale_id where Y.cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} and Y.sale_id = #{saleId}

SELECT Y.sale_id ,X.prdct_id ,(select name from lens_detail where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) prdct_name ,(select curve from lens_detail where prdct_id = X.prdct_id) curve ,X.prdct_cnt ,X.prc ,X.asmbly ,X.dlvry ,X.dscnt_prcnt ,X.earn_prcnt ,X.using_point ,X.inform FROM sale_off Y inner join salePrdct_off X on Y.sale_id = X.sale_id where X.itemTy=2 and Y.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} and Y.sale_id=#{saleId}

SELECT Y.sale_id ,X.prdct_id ,(select prdct_name from clens where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) prdct_name ,(select color_name from prdct_color C WHERE C.color_id = (select color_id from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) color_name ,X.prdct_cnt ,X.prc ,X.asmbly ,X.dlvry ,X.dscnt_prcnt ,X.earn_prcnt ,X.using_point ,X.inform FROM sale_off Y inner join salePrdct_off X on Y.sale_id = X.sale_id where X.itemTy=3 and Y.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} and Y.sale_id=#{saleId}

SELECT Y.sale_id ,X.prdct_id ,(select prdct_name from clens_acc where prdct_id=X.prdct_id) prdct_name ,(select color_name from prdct_color C WHERE C.color_id = (select color_id from prdct where prdct_id= X.prdct_id)) color_name ,X.prdct_cnt ,X.prc ,X.asmbly ,X.dlvry ,X.dscnt_prcnt ,X.earn_prcnt ,X.using_point ,X.inform FROM sale_off Y inner join salePrdct_off X on Y.sale_id = X.sale_id where X.itemTy=4 and Y.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} and Y.sale_id=#{saleId}

SELECT Y.sale_id ,X.prdct_id ,X.prdct_name ,X.prdct_cnt ,X.prc ,X.asmbly ,X.dlvry ,X.dscnt_prcnt ,X.earn_prcnt ,X.using_point ,X.inform ,X.item_ty FROM sale_off Y INNER JOIN new_prdct X ON Y.sale_id = X.sale_id WHERE Y.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} and Y.sale_id=#{saleId}

SELECT prdct_id ,prdct_name ,brand_id ,(select brand_name from brand where brand_id=A.brand_id) brand_name ,(select server_url from file_server where isdefault='1') url_str ,(select img_path from still_img where prdct_id=A.prdct_id limit 1) img_path ,(select count(*) from rotate_img where prdct_id=A.prdct_id AND media_ty_cd='00200002') multi_img_cnt ,(select video_cd from video where model_name=A.prdct_name) video_cd ,mnf_country ,wh_date ,prdct_ty_cd ,prdct_stat_ty_cd ,prdct_visible_cd ,puchas_prc ,trde_prc ,reg_time ,upd_time FROM prdct A WHERE prdct_id=#{prdctId}
